metadata.limits: A matching catalogue signature does not prove its implementation remains correct; old dispositions are historical and are not automatically applied to current controls. Each new verdict is limited to its cited assertions and fixture; source-reviewed availability expressions and untested conditional variants are not runtime passes.

supplementalControlEvidence.reportType: Latest executed result per unique case, with sourceReport provenance and all raw attempts retained; not a single clean 68-case run.
